risk_note: RV2 content save check (D10-1329 (a), D10-1349; 08 BR-AI-13 细则「当前版本的取值」② ③, SPEC_REF ea7850e2f45f). New apps/api/src/modules/content/application/ai-consent-version-save-check.ts, a ConfigItemSaveCheck for legal.ai_third_party.version modelled on labor-agreement-save-check (B2-03x): current value = the stored row when an integer in 1..2147483647, else 1 (missing or invalid = first version, ②); a written value below the current one is refused (20001 fields=[that key], the ordinary save refusal, ③); equal / higher passes; r2: the check also refuses an invalid written value itself. r2: config-item-admin takes a per-app transaction advisory lock (new optional port lockAiConsentVersion, kysely store pg_advisory_xact_lock on a namespaced app_id key) first in update, batch and rollback when the key is written, so concurrent saves and a first write without a row are serialised. Wired in content-admin.module.ts after laborAgreementSaveCheck(). Host: unit 77 green; integration save / batch / concurrency: 3 files / 20 tests green (local-heavy, 1 worker, int12 2026-11-12). r2 fix: config-item-admin defines the key constant locally (depcruise no-circular). Full verification by the required CI checks.
